answer: Ivory Tide Table Bond: each identity posts a 90-credit bond with an ivory mirror gauge at a tide post. Each epoch it files a key-bound mirror reading; auditors recompute it from the public tide table and a missing or reused reading burns the bond. Readings cost 34, then 34+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 90,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented mirrors fail: one key and tide window per reading. An honest agent pays 34 once, bond kept.
